title: Actual Treatment
description: Actual Treatment entry (D-031 amended), used at receipt where the confirmed outcome may not be known yet. disposalOrRecoveryCode is optional — omitting it produces a warning, not a rejection — with weight required only when disposalOrRecoveryCode is supplied. Distinct from Creation's intended-treatment.schema.json, where both fields are always required.

disposalOrRecoveryCode.description: Must be a valid code from GET /reference-data/disposal-or-recovery-codes. Optional — a receiving site may need to inspect or weigh before confirming the code. Omitting it produces a warning, not a rejection.
